notes.title: Title: Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite PC Update 1.03 now available [Oct. 17, 2017]
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE:[/b] Sigma, Black Panther, and Monster Hunter should now show up individually on your DLC tab for [i]Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite[/i], and should now be useable within the game. We thank you for your patience and support.

[strike]We are aware of the issues users are experiencing with the Character DLC released today and we are investigating this issue further. We appreciate your patience and support, and apologize for the inconvenience.[/strike]

---

[i]“Let’s get this party started!”[/i]

The latest patch for [i]Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite[/i] is now available. This patch fixes a few major bugs with certain characters and mechanics. 

Additionally, the first three characters of the Character Pass – Black Panther, Sigma, and Monster Hunter are now available for purchase. Character Pass owners will automatically receive these characters once the game is updated.

18 new Premium Costumes are now available for purchase via the Steam Store. Alternatively, these costumes can be purchased in three different packs (Avenging Army, World Warriors, Mystic Masters) that include six Premium Costumes each.

For more details, please visit the following Capcom-Unity blog links:
[list]
[*][url=http://www.capcom-unity.com/strumslinger/blog/2017/10/13/patch-notes-for-marvel-vs-capcom-infinite-october-16-update]Patch Notes for Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite – October 16 Update[/url]
[*][url=http://www.capcom-unity.com/strumslinger/blog/2017/10/16/battle-in-style-with-these-new-premium-costumes-available-on-october-17-in-marvel-vs-capcom-infinite]Battle in style with these new Premium Costumes available on October 17 in Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite![/url]
[*][url=http://www.capcom-unity.com/strumslinger/blog/2017/10/17/black-panther-sigma-and-monster-hunter-have-joined-the-fight-in-marvel-vs-capcom-infinite]Black Panther, Sigma, and Monster Hunter have joined the fight in Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite![/url]
[/list]
Once again, thank you for your support of [i]Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite[/i]!

Best Regards,

CAPCOM USA Customer Support

For the latest news and information from CAPCOM, please visit us at [url=http://www.capcom-unity.com]Capcom-Unity[/url].

notes.content:

A new patch update has been released for the Steam version of [i]Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite[/i] that addresses the following, known issue:

[list]
[*]Fixed issue where Voice Chat Volume (Speaker) settings are not saved after you close and relaunch the application. 
[/list]
